payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over each start index, uses next-non-1 array to skip ones, accumulates product and sum, breaks when product > 1e18, and checks condition within ones intervals efficiently.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates subsegments but prunes using an explicit bound (product > 1e18) and determines if condition can be met within a block of consecutive ones, resembling branch and bound search.
